quizName:
Sign Test
									  					
									  														  					Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this road sign tell you?

options.text: The safe speed limit for a residential area.
The safe speed limit for an expressway exit.
The safe speed limit for an expressway entrance.
The safe speed limit for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The safe speed limit for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the safe speed for a highway exit. In this example, the safe speed is 30 mph.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are allowed on the upcoming narrow bridge.
The bridge ahead has one-way traffic only.
The bridge ahead can fit only one car at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to pass or meet a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to pass or meet a truck.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns drivers that the bridge ahead is narrow and they may not be able to pass a truck safely. Drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you that traffic from the right is merging. Be ready to let them merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. This sign tells you that a divided highway is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: A railroad crossing is coming. Get ready to stop.
You will always stop at the railroad crossing ahead.
Stop and wait for a signal before crossing the railroad tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: A railroad crossing is coming. Get ready to stop.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you of a railroad crossing ahead. Look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop. Wait for trains to pass before you continue.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you the road will curve sharply to the right and then sharply to the left.

questions.question: What does this black and yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is one-way only.
There is a detour to the right due to road work.
The road ahead changes direction sharply.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead changes direction sharply.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the road ahead will turn sharply. Slow down and prepare for a sudden change in direction.

questions.question: What does this black and yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is one-way only.
There is a detour to the right because of road work.
Slow down because the road ahead changes direction sharply.
There is a crossroad to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down because the road ahead changes direction sharply.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road ahead will turn sharply. Slow down as much as you would at an intersection before you reach the curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
Your road meets a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your road meets a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that your road crosses a divided highway. A divided highway has two separate one-way roads with a median or barrier between them.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: One lane is ending. Move left soon.

questions.correctAnswerText: One lane is ending. Move left soon.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that a lane is ending and you need to merge to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: A curve in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A curve in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road curves to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign tells drivers to watch for people crossing the road.

questions.question: This is a ____ sign.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign is a "Yield" sign. Slow down and check for traffic. Let pedestrians and other vehicles cross first. Only stop if you must.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are entering a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.
Come to a complete stop before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are entering a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: If you pass these signs, you are going the wrong way. You risk a head-on collision. Turn around carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign shows a crosswalk. Watch for people crossing and let them pass safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulatory sign tells drivers that U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to stop.
You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: The stop sign is eight-sided. When you see it, you must stop completely. Do not proceed until it is safe and clear.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns drivers to watch for bicycles crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and be ready to stop if cars are approaching.
Come to a full stop, then proceed when safe.
Proceed carefully through the intersection without always stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop, then proceed when safe.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. Come to a complete stop at the marked stop line. If there is no stop line, stop before the crosswalk. If there is no crosswalk, stop where you can see oncoming traffic. Only proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign says U-turns are not allowed. You may see this sign at intersections with heavy traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn in the direction shown by the arrow. In this case, you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a divided highway is ahead. The road will split into two separate one-way roads with a median between them. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A community service group is picking up trash ahead.
Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that workers may be on or near the roadway ahead. Drive carefully through this area.

questions.question: This sign shows what type of road condition?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black symbols. They alert you to conditions ahead. This sign warns that another road crosses this highway ahead.

questions.question: What type of sign is this?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black symbols. They warn drivers about hazards or special situations ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a stop sign is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: This sign shows what type of road condition?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an intersection with a crossing road is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round yellow sign means a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The highway ahead is under construction or maintenance.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is under construction or maintenance.
questions.explanation: Construction signs are orange and warn drivers of work zones ahead. Slow down and drive carefully through these areas.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive slowly and honk your horn.
You are entering a school parking lot.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell drivers about dangers ahead. This sign warns you that a school zone is coming. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts drivers that bicycles may cross the road ahead.

questions.question: When you see an octagonal sign, you must:
questions.explanation: An octagonal (eight-sided) sign always means stop. Come to a complete stop. Yield to other traffic and pedestrians. Then proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What is this bicyclist signaling?
questions.explanation: Bicycles don't have turn signals. Bicyclists use hand and arm signals instead. A left arm straight out means the bicyclist is turning left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left. It is illegal and unsafe to turn left where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep downhill grade is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to immediate dangers. This sign warns drivers about a winding road with curves ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you should stop and:

options.text: Check for vehicles in your direction only, then go.
Let all vehicles arrive before or after you go first.
Check for traffic in all directions before going.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check for traffic in all directions before going.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, come to a full stop. Look in all directions for traffic. Then proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that an intersection is ahead. A road joins from the right side.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Right turn on red light permitted with caution.
All traffic must turn right at next intersection.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means no right turns are permitted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign means you cannot park here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided red sign means "Stop."

questions.question: If you see a flashing red traffic light, you should:

options.text: Be traveling in the wrong direction.
Treat the intersection like a stop sign.
Wait until it turns green before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Treat the intersection like a stop sign.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light works like a stop sign. Come to a complete stop. Yield to all other traffic and pedestrians before entering the intersection.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you should:

options.text: Watch for traffic merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for traffic merging from the right.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to dangers ahead. This sign warns you that traffic may merge into your lane from the right.

questions.question: What information do blue traffic signs provide?
questions.explanation: Blue signs provide information about services for drivers. These include rest areas, food, gas, and hospitals.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. Slow down on wet pavement because it takes longer to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a school crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round sign always means a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black text on a yellow background. This sign warns drivers that the road becomes slippery when wet. Slow down and be careful because your vehicle may be harder to control.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: The height from the road to the bottom of the bridge or overpass.
The maximum legal height for vehicles in this state.
The maximum width for vehicles on the highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The height from the road to the bottom of the bridge or overpass.
questions.explanation: This is a low clearance warning sign. It shows how much space is between the road and the bottom of a bridge or overpass. Tall vehicles must know their height to avoid hitting the structure.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Road construction or maintenance work ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Road construction or maintenance work ahead.
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn of hazards ahead. Orange warning signs are used in construction or maintenance areas. Slow down and be prepared for changes in road conditions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black text. This sign tells you the right lane is ending. Be ready for traffic to merge and move to another lane if needed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black text and prepare you for upcoming conditions. This sign warns you that a T intersection is ahead. Be ready to turn left or right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This three-sided sign means yield. Slow down and be ready to stop. Let other drivers or pedestrians go first. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road may be slippery when wet. Drive carefully on wet roads because it is harder to control your vehicle.

questions.question: If you see this sign above your lane, you:

options.text: Can continue through or exit from your current lane.
Can stay in your lane and continue through the interchange.
Must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means that lane ends at an exit ramp. If you stay in that lane, you will have to exit. You can change lanes to continue on the freeway, or stay in the lane and exit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Right lane ending; fewer lanes ahead.
Left lane ending; fewer lanes ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Right lane ending; fewer lanes ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the right lane is ending soon. Be ready to move to another lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to watch for bicycles crossing the road. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is only for vehicles with a certain number of people inside.
Specific turns are allowed from specific lanes.
Drivers in both lanes must merge carefully.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is only for vehicles with a certain number of people inside.
questions.explanation: This is a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane sign. It means the left lane is reserved for buses and cars with a driver and at least one passenger.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that people may cross the road ahead. Watch for pedestrians and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes going the same direction will soon become one lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that you are leaving a separated highway and will soon drive on a road with traffic going both directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that a sharp turn is coming and you should reduce your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the road ahead is divided. Stay to the right of the divider.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that you cannot turn left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead has a series of turns or curves.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the road will be slippery when wet and you should drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves only to the right.
The road ahead turns sharply to the right.
The road ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
The road ahead curves to the left and then to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the road curves right and then left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red line through it means something is not allowed. This sign means you cannot make a U-turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for people with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign is posted on one-way streets and roads where you cannot enter. You may see this sign if you try to enter an expressway ramp going the wrong way.

questions.question: What does a sign with this shape mean?
questions.explanation: A pennant-shaped sign marks the start of a no passing zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can travel in either direction in this lane.
You are approaching a divided highway.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic is moving in both directions.

questions.question: This white sign means you should not pass other vehicles:

options.text: Until after you pass the sign.
Unless it seems safe to do so.

questions.explanation: A white rectangular sign means you must follow the rule. This sign means do not pass other vehicles under any circumstances.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep driving at your current speed.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means right turns are not allowed. Do not turn right where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Don't drink if you are going to drive.
The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: This sign warns you are approaching:
questions.explanation: A round sign warns of a railroad crossing ahead. It is posted a few hundred feet before the tracks. Slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a winding road ahead.

questions.question: This is the shape and color of a ____ sign.
questions.explanation: A downward-facing triangle sign means you must yield. Slow down to a safe speed and stop if needed. If you stop, do so at the marked stop line.

questions.question: This red and white sign means you should:

options.text: Stop and check for traffic coming from both directions before proceeding.
Give the right-of-way to traffic on the road you wish to enter or cross.
Maintain a steady speed and check for traffic coming from all directions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Give the right-of-way to traffic on the road you wish to enter or cross.
questions.explanation: A three-sided yield sign means you must slow down and be ready to stop if needed. Let any vehicle, cyclist, or pedestrian pass before you go. You do not have the right-of-way.

questions.question: From the center lane, which maneuver(s) can you perform?
questions.explanation: This sign shows a lane for left-turning vehicles only. You cannot use this lane for passing or driving straight through.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns you of low clearance ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that traffic may enter from a side road ahead.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign means the road ahead has a sharp right turn followed by a sharp left turn.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that traffic will merge from the right.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign means left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign means stay to the right to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red line through it means that action is not allowed. Right turns are prohibited where this sign is posted.

questions.question: You see a "Merging traffic" sign on the freeway. What should you do?

options.text: Speed up to avoid slowing traffic.
Change lanes, if safe, to make room for entering traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change lanes, if safe, to make room for entering traffic.
questions.explanation: On a road with two or more lanes, make room for vehicles entering. If the next lane is empty, move over one lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are not allowed on the hill ahead.
Trucks are on the hill ahead.

questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that a steep hill or downgrade is coming.

questions.question: What should you do at a flashing yellow light?

options.text: Stop and wait until the intersection is clear.

questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means slow down and proceed with caution. You do not need to stop completely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down; a curving road is ahead.
Slow down and do not use your brakes.
Slow down; the road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down; the road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead becomes slippery in wet conditions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Parking spaces are reserved for persons with disabilities.

questions.correctAnswerText: Parking spaces are reserved for persons with disabilities.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces for drivers with disability plates or disability placards.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers they are leaving a divided road and entering a two-way highway.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you about the road ahead?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves to the right, then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disability permits.
Traffic in this lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
Lanes are reserved for buses and carpool vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disability permits.
questions.explanation: This sign shows parking spaces are reserved for drivers with disability permits.

questions.question: What does the posted speed limit show?

options.text: The exact speed you must drive to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe speed when road and weather are good.
The maximum safe speed in all conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed when road and weather are good.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the highest legal speed for that road. You may need to drive slower than the limit. When conditions are bad, you must slow down.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must drive at this speed.
The highest legal speed is 55 mph.
You must drive through the intersection at this speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highest legal speed is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the highest legal speed on this road. In rain, snow, ice, or other bad conditions, drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low ground railroad crossing. Railroad tracks cross the road at a steep slope. Low vehicles may drag or get stuck on the tracks.

questions.question: This sign warns you that you are coming to:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a four-way intersection is ahead.

questions.question: At a school crossing sign, what should you do?

options.text: Always stop, even if there is no stop sign.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children cross the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Always yield to pedestrians in or entering a crosswalk. Stay alert for pedestrians when driving through intersections or turning.

questions.question: What does this sign tell a driver?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a flagger is ahead. Always follow the flagger's directions. Flaggers wear orange or yellow vests, yellow-green shirts, or bright jackets. They use paddles and red flags to direct traffic through work zones.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and let trains pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let trains pass.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a railroad crossing is ahead. Always slow down at railroad crossings. Trains cannot stop for cars, so you must let them pass first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a yield sign is ahead. Start slowing down when you see this warning sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you must stay to the right of the divider ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may go ahead if the road is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a one-way road, entrance, or exit. If you see this sign, traffic is coming toward you. Turn around if you are driving toward it.

questions.question: What type of sign is this?
questions.explanation: A triangular sign pointing downward is always a yield sign. You must be ready to slow down or stop when you see a yield sign.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has a series of turns and curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign show?
questions.explanation: Pentagon-shaped signs mean you are in or near a school zone or school crossing. Watch for children and follow the posted speed limits.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must bear right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must bear right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a Y intersection ahead. You must choose to go right or left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Last turn before a toll road.

questions.explanation: Orange signs mean work zone activity. When you see orange signs, cones, or barrels, stay alert for unsafe driving conditions. This sign tells you a flagger is ahead. You must follow their directions.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low overhead. Do not go ahead if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign (13 feet 6 inches in this case).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red and white triangular sign means you must yield the right-of-way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow background. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns of a steep hill. Adjust your speed to drive safely.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: You cannot turn around to go in the opposite direction at this location.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left, then right.
The road ahead curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: The road curves to the right and then to the left. Slow down to safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep downhill section is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you about a steep hill ahead. Adjust your speed to avoid brake damage and accidents.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Deer cross the road in this area. Slow down, stay alert, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A crossroad is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A person with a flag is ahead controlling traffic in a construction area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Traffic may be coming toward you from the opposite direction.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are approaching you.
Come to a full stop and go when it is safe to do so.
Proceed carefully through the intersection, not always stopping.
Stop only for traffic on an intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop and go when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: You must come to a complete stop and let vehicles and pedestrians pass. Go again when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people crossing your path.

questions.explanation: Road work is coming up. Stay alert for temporary traffic control signs and devices.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this road sign?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign tells you a divided highway is starting. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a hospital with emergency services is located to the right.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
